name: snipd
description: Access and search millions of podcast transcripts, summaries, and rich metadata. Ask questions, research guests, turn text into audio, and fully control the Snipd podcast app.

interface.longDescription:
This plugin lets you:
1. Get transcripts, summaries, and rich metadata such as chapters, guest bios, and popularity scores of millions of podcasts
2. Search through millions of podcast transcripts or search for episodes, shows, and guests
3. Control the Snipd podcast app such as queueing episodes, following shows, exporting snips, uploading audio or turning text into audio

Use Cases - without the app
- Get the main insights of a podcast
- Ask questions and get answers based on an episode, show or guest
- Look up something you heard on a podcast
- Monitor new episodes for specific topics and guests
- Recommend podcasts based on your interests
- Enrich your personal knowledge wikis (pkm) with podcast data
- Research what competitors have revealed on a podcast
- Discover interesting guests
- And much more...

Use Cases - with the app
- Export and organise your snips (=highlights) with transcript, summary, and metadata
- Triage new episodes and add the best ones to your queue
- Upload audio files
- Turn a web article into audio and listen on the app
- Create custom podcasts on a topic you want to learn more about
- Create custom notes on a podcast
- Analyse your listening behaviour over time
- Find all insights you've ever heard on a certain topic
- And much more...

What is Snipd?
Snipd is the #1 podcast app for knowledge seekers.
Available on iOS and Android and loved across the world by people who listen to learn.
This plugin also works without the Snipd podcast app.
capabilities: Get transcripts, summaries, chapters, guest bios and popularity scores of millions of podcasts
Search through millions of podcast transcripts
Search for episodes, shows and guests
Ask questions about an episode, show or guest
Export and organise your snips with transcript, summary and metadata
Follow shows and guests and triage their new episodes
Queue episodes and control the Snipd podcast app
Upload audio files and YouTube videos
Turn text such as a web article into audio
defaultPrompt: What did Huberman say about morning sunlight?
Create a weekly briefing with the best insights from the podcasts I follow
Every Monday, recommend a great episode based on my interests

positive.description: List the user's saved snips with their notes, episode and show
positive.prompt: Show my most recent Snipd snips grouped by episode, with my notes.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's newest snips grouped by episode, each with the episode and show title, the snip's note or summary, its position in the episode and its tags.

positive.description: Tag snips, asking before changing the account
positive.prompt: Tag my three most recent Snipd snips with "to review".
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the three newest snips, confirms the change with the user, then files them under the tag "to review" (created if missing). The tag shows on those snips in the Snipd app.

positive.description: See new episodes from followed podcasts and queue one
positive.prompt: What's new in the podcasts I follow on Snipd? Queue the newest episode to play next.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent unplayed episodes from the followed podcasts, newest first, then adds the newest one at the front of the play queue and confirms it. The queue in the Snipd app shows it next.

positive.description: Search what was said across followed podcasts
positive.prompt: Find moments in the podcasts I follow on Snipd where they talk about sleep.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns transcript passages about sleep from episodes of followed podcasts, each with the episode, show, timestamp and a link to the moment.

positive.description: Recap the last listened episode with its AI snips
positive.prompt: What was the last podcast episode I listened to on Snipd, and what were its key points?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the most recently played episode and show with the listening progress, then summarizes the episode's AI snips as its key points.

negative.description: Podcast hosting and publishing is not something Snipd does
negative.prompt: Publish my new podcast episode to Apple Podcasts and Spotify.

negative.description: Music libraries in other apps are out of scope
negative.prompt: Add the album I'm listening to on Spotify to my library.

negative.description: Highlights in books or documents are not podcast snips
negative.prompt: Highlight the second paragraph of this PDF and save it to my Kindle notes.
